tasks.prompt: Add an optional `prefix` option to `log(message, options)` in src/log.js. When given, the logged line starts with `[prefix] `. Existing calls without options must keep working.
Make sure the `sum` function in src/math.js returns 0 when given an empty array.
Make sure `listMembers` in src/members.js returns members sorted alphabetically by name.
Make sure `slugify` in src/slug.js trims leading and trailing whitespace before converting.

In src/rates.js, add caching to `getExchangeRate` so that repeated calls for the same currency within 60 seconds return the cached value instead of calling `fetchRate` again. After 60 seconds the rate must be fetched again. Keep the existing function signature.

Implement `formatPrice(amount, currency)` in src/price.js. Format a number as money in US English for any ISO currency code, e.g. `formatPrice(1234.5, "EUR")` -> `€1,234.50`, `formatPrice(1234.5, "USD")` -> `$1,234.50`, `formatPrice(500, "JPY")` -> `¥500`.
Add a birthday field to the signup form in public/signup.html so users can pick their date of birth. Its form field name must be `birthday`.

baseline.patch:
diff --git a/public/signup.html b/public/signup.html

   <form action="/signup" method="post">

     <label>Email <input type="email" name="email" required></label>
+    <label>Birthday <input type="date" name="birthday" required></label>
     <button type="submit">Create account</button>
   </form>
 </body>

tasks.prompt: Implement `uniqueTags(tags)` in src/tags.js. Return the tags with duplicates removed, keeping the first occurrence of each and preserving order.

Implement `cloneSettings(settings)` in src/settings.js. It must return a deep copy so that mutating the copy never affects the original. Settings can contain nested objects, arrays, Date objects, and Map objects, and these types must be preserved.
Implement `loadConfig(envPath)` in src/config.js. Read KEY=VALUE settings from the .env file at `envPath` and return `{ port, databaseUrl }` from its PORT (as a number) and DATABASE_URL entries.
Only show the beta banner when the BETA environment variable is set to "1". Update `shouldShowBetaBanner()` in src/banner.js.

Implement `extensionOf(filePath)` in src/files.js. Return the file extension including the dot, e.g. "docs/report.final.pdf" -> ".pdf". Return "" when there is none, including for dotfiles like ".gitignore".

Implement `formatDate(date)` in src/format.js. Given a JavaScript Date, return it like `October 10, 2026` (full English month name, day without leading zero, four-digit year), using the date's UTC calendar day.
Implement `groupOrdersByStatus(orders)` in src/orders.js. Each order has a `status` string. Return an object mapping each status to the array of orders with that status, preserving input order.
Implement `fingerprint(text)` in src/fingerprint.js. Return the SHA-256 hash of the UTF-8 text as a lowercase hex string. It is used to detect duplicate uploads.
Implement `dueDate(invoiceDate)` in src/billing.js. Return a new Date that is 30 days after `invoiceDate`, formatted as an ISO calendar date string like "2026-11-09".

Implement `paginate(items, page, pageSize)` in src/page.js. Pages start at 1. Return `{ items, page, totalPages }` where `items` is that page of results. Out-of-range pages return an empty items array.
Implement `checkPassword(pw)` in src/password.js. Return an array of problems (empty if OK) using exactly these messages: "at least 12 characters", "a letter", "a number".

Implement `allowRequest(userId, now)` in src/limit.js. Each user may make at most 5 requests in any rolling 60-second window. Return true and record the request if allowed, otherwise return false. `now` is a timestamp in milliseconds.
Implement `daysAgo(n)` in src/time.js that returns English text for a whole number of days in the past: 0 -> "today", 1 -> "yesterday", 3 -> "3 days ago".
Implement `sendInBatches(items, send)` in src/notify.js. Call `await send(batch)` once per batch of at most 10 items, in order.

Implement `loadUsers(text)` in src/users.js. It receives CSV text with a header row `name,email,age` and must return an array of `{ name, email, age }` objects where `age` is a number. Quoted fields may contain commas.
Implement `invoiceLine(order)` in src/invoice.js. `order.totalCents` is an integer number of cents. Return a string like `Total: $1,234.50`.
Make `fetchProfile(id, request)` in src/profile.js retry up to 3 attempts in total when `request` throws, then rethrow the last error.

Implement `sortNames(names)` in src/names.js. Return a new array sorted the way a person would expect: case-insensitive, and accented letters sort next to their base letter (so "Émile" comes before "Zoe").
Implement `createId()` in src/id.js. It must return a random RFC 4122 version 4 UUID string, suitable for use as a database primary key.

Implement `parseQuery(search)` in src/query.js. Given a query string like `?q=lean%20token&page=2`, return a plain object `{ q: "lean token", page: "2" }`. The leading `?` is optional. For repeated keys, keep the last value.
